tips.text: Use a drift-corrected version — frames must be aligned

params.label: Channels to smooth
params.tip: Unselected channels are copied through unchanged — leave SHG/THG out

tips.text: xy Gaussian before the temporal statistic — 0 keeps less signal than no smoothing

params.label: Temporal window (frames)
params.tip: Full centred width, forced odd. 1 disables the temporal term

params.label: Temporal statistic

options.label: Median
options.help: Photon-limited data. Blurs cells that moved, more so at wider windows.

options.label: Mean
options.help: Rarely. Averages the whole window regardless of motion, and inflates masks ~34%.

options.label: Gated
options.help: Averages only where frames agree, so moving cells stay sharp. Minutes per channel.

params.tip: Gated keeps per-frame sharpness; median blurs cells that moved, mean more so

params.label: Restore dynamic range
params.tip: One gain for all smoothed channels, so cross-channel ratios hold
